title: Circle Centre and Radius
summary: Centre and radius from the general circle equation. 42 bytes.

body.text: Prompts A (the common x² and y² coefficient), then D, E, F in Ax² + Ay² + Dx + Ey + F = 0. Pauses: h, k, r where centre is (−D/2A, −E/2A).

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 42 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).

body.caption: x² + y² − 4x + 6y − 12 = 0 is the circle centre (2, −3), radius 5.

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: x² + y² − 4x + 6y − 12 = 0.
Question: Use this program to solve the case: 2x² + 2y² − 8x + 0y − 8 = 0.
Given: Same circle as (x−2)² + y² = 6, scaled by 2.
Question: Use this program to solve the case: Point ‘circle’ (radius 0).

items: Centre (1, 2). Radius 0 — a single point, not a curve

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: If A = 0 this is a line, not a circle (Math ERROR on the last pause). Complete the square by hand to check.
